Adl Tips: The indicator lights show the trader’s priority ranking in the Auto-Deleveraging system. Each light represents a 20% increase in priority. When all lights are on, the trader is at the highest priority in the ADL queue.
AllLeverTipsModal: In Cross Margin mode, if liquidation occurs, all available balance of the corresponding margin asset may be lost. Please adjust carefully.
CancelAllTpConfirm: Confirm cancel all Take Profit orders?
CancelAllTpSlSuccessDec: All {{side}} TP/SL orders have been canceled
Filled/Total-Tip: “Filled” refers to the quantity already executed, while “Total” refers to the total quantity of the order.
MoreLeverTipsModal: Your current leverage is high, please be aware of the risks
Qty-Tip: Number of futures held in your position
UnrealizedPnlTips1: The default unrealized PnL is calculated based on the latest market price.
UnrealizedPnlTips2: Hover here to view unrealized PnL calculated using the Mark Price.
actOrderCancelSucDesc: The order for {{type}}{{qty}} {{symbol}} futures at {{price}} has been canceled.
actPostOnlyOrderCancelDesc: Your passive order for {{type}}{{qty}} {{symbol}} futures at {{price}} would be executed as a taker order. Therefore, the order has been automatically canceled.
activateModalDescDeduct: Activation will deduct trading fees using rebate vouchers. The corresponding deduction amount covers the trading fees incurred for each transaction.
activateModalDescExperience: Activation requirement: owned funds in futures account ≥ {{minTokenLimit}} {{token}}. After successful activation, you can view the bonus amount in "Assets".
activateModalTitleDeduct: Confirm activation of the Futures Fee Voucher?
activateModalTitleExperience: Confirm activation of futures trial bonus?
activateModalWarningDeduct: Deducted amounts will not be eligible for referral rebates or affiliate rebates.
activateModalWarningExperience: Expiration of the bonus may lead to liquidation or the invalidation of active open orders.
activePrice-Tip: The activation price is the condition to activate the trailing exit. When the latest market trade price reaches or exceeds the activation price, the trailing TP/SL order will be activated. After activation, the system will calculate the actual market price to close the position. If no activation price is set, the trailing TP/SL will be activated immediately once placed.
addMarginFailNoticeDesc: Please ensure your account has sufficient available balance
addMarginSucNoticeDesc: Liquidation triggered, {{margin}} USDT margin has been automatically added to your {{symbol}}{{side}} position.
adlNoticeDesc: Your {{qty}} {{symbol}}{{side}} futures position has been reduced at price {{price}}
adlTips: This indicator shows your ranking in the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) queue. If all indicators are lit, your position may be reduced when a liquidation event occurs.
animationModalDesc: The order table notification bar will no longer appear
audioSoundTips: Once enabled, a sound notification will play when an order is executed
bustRiskWarning: The gap between the current price and the estimated liquidation price is too small, posing a high liquidation risk
cOrderCancelSucDesc: The order for {{type}} {{qty}} {{symbol}} futures at trigger price {{triggerPrice}} has been canceled
calcResAsReference: Calculation results are for reference only
calcResAsReferenceInLiq: Calculation results are for reference only. This liquidation price only represents data for a single position direction under the futures
calculatorTip: Calculation results are for reference only. Trading fees or funding rates may cause deviations in actual results
cancelAllModalDesc: Once enabled, canceling all orders requires a second confirmation
cancelBatchPartialSuccess: {{size}} active orders canceled successfully, {{failSize}} failed to cancel. Please try again
clearingPrice-Tip: The bankruptcy price is the execution price determined by the exchange under the forced liquidation mechanism to quickly close positions and minimize losses. In isolated mode, the liquidation amount is the margin of that position; in cross mode, it is the total margin of all positions plus the wallet balance. If there is remaining margin after liquidation, it will be transferred to the insurance fund of the trading pair. If additional losses occur due to market volatility, the insurance fund will cover them.
closeAllTipWithStock: Please note: Since the Stock RWA market is closed, your RWA stock positions will not be included in this liquidation process.
closeMarkPrice-Tip: This mark price represents the mark price at the moment of liquidation. When the mark price reaches or exceeds the liquidation price, forced liquidation will be triggered. For long positions, liquidation occurs when the mark price falls below the liquidation price; for short positions, it occurs when the mark price rises above the liquidation price.
closeOnTriggerTips: Close orders will only reduce your position and will not increase it. If your available margin is insufficient when the close order is triggered, other orders for this futures will be canceled or reduced one by one.
closedTips: Will close {{qty}} futures at {{price}}, estimated {{type}} is {{unRealised}}{{coin}}
commonClosedP&L: Realized PnL represents the profit and loss of a position after it is closed, excluding trading fees and funding fees incurred during the holding period.
crossMarginModelExplain: Cross Margin Mode: All cross-margin positions share the total account balance. In a liquidation event, traders may lose the entire account balance and all cross positions.
crossMaxLeveragePopTip: Cross Margin Leverage: The system uses the maximum leverage allowed by the current risk limit by default to determine initial margin. You can adjust it via Trading Preferences → Risk Limit Settings.
crossMaxLeverageTip: Maximum Leverage: In Cross Margin mode you cannot manually adjust leverage or initial margin. The system will use the maximum leverage allowed by the current risk limit. To reduce it, adjust the risk limit in Trading Preferences.
crossTrueLeverageTip: Effective Leverage ({{ effectiveLever }}): in Cross Margin mode it is calculated as position value divided by the maximum available margin (available margin + position margin).
currentEntrustRecordTip: Only the latest 100 records within the past 180 days are shown
disableAutoAddMarginSuccess: Auto add margin setting canceled successfully
distance-Tip: Distance between the last price and trigger price
downRiskNoticeDesc: The tiered margin for {{symbol}} {{side}} has been adjusted from {{oldLimit}} to {{newLimit}}.
errorCode30017: Order price cannot be lower than liquidation price
errorCode30018: Order price cannot be higher than liquidation price
exitType-Tip: Exit types include trade and forced liquidation
filled-type-Tip: Execution types include trades and liquidations
filledPrice-Tip: Execution price is the average price of multiple fills in the order
fluidity-direction-Tip: Indicates whether your order executed as a Taker or Maker
fullTpsl-Tip: Only one TP/SL can be set for the entire position. When the trigger price is reached, the whole position will be closed with a market order.
fullWarehouseExchangeTip: In Cross Margin mode, this action will affect your Futures position liquidation price.
fundingRateDescTips: Funding fees are exchanged periodically between Long and Short positions (based on the time displayed online). If the rate is positive, Long positions pay Shorts; if negative, the opposite applies. Funding Fee = Position Value × Funding Rate.
hoverTipsConditional: A Trigger Order will only be activated after the preset trigger price is reached. You can use Trigger Orders for Stop Loss, Take Profit, or breakout entries.
hoverTipsLimit: Limit orders are used to buy or sell at a specified price or better.
hoverTipsMarket: Market orders are the fastest execution method and will use the best available price in the order book. Due to price volatility, the final execution price may differ from expectations.
hoverTipsPosContracts: Futures contract code for this position
hoverTipsPosLiq: The estimated liquidation price is affected by leverage and position margin. If the mark price reaches it, the position will be liquidated.
hoverTipsPosMargin: Position margin is the initial margin. In Isolated Mode, you can add extra margin or adjust leverage to change the position margin.
hoverTipsPosTPSL: You can set or cancel TP/SL and trailing stop here. Once set, you can view the related orders in the position panel.
hoverTipsPosUnrealized: Unrealized PnL and ROI of this position
hoverTipsTotalPosRealized: The cumulative realized PnL of this position since opening (including fees and funding if applicable). After fully closing the position, the realized PnL will reset.
hoverTipsUnrealized: Unrealized PnL is an estimate and may differ significantly from actual PnL during extreme market volatility.
isolatedMarginModelExplain: Isolated Mode: A specific amount of margin is allocated to the position. If the margin falls below the required maintenance margin, the position will be liquidated. You can add extra margin to this position.
klineCancelOrderContent: Once enabled, quick cancel requires a second confirmation.
klineClosePositionContent: Once enabled, quick close requires a second confirmation.
leverageModalDesc: Once enabled, leverage confirmation requires a second confirmation.
liquidationPrice-Tip: When the mark price reaches the liquidation price, your position will be liquidated.
localTimeTips: Please set your PC time to the correct local time to avoid inaccurate chart data.
longSideSlMorePrice: The Stop Loss price is higher than the latest price and will be filled immediately. Please reset it.
longSideSlMorePrice-condition: The Stop Loss price is higher than the trigger price and will be filled immediately. Please reset it.
longSideSlMorePrice-limit: The Stop Loss price is higher than the order price and will be filled immediately. Please reset it.
longSideTpLessPrice: The Take Profit price is lower than the latest price and will be filled immediately. Please reset it.
longSideTpLessPrice-condition: The Take Profit price is lower than the trigger price and will be filled immediately. Please reset it.
longSideTpLessPrice-limit: The Take Profit price is lower than the order price and will be filled immediately. Please reset it.
lvgHighLimitTips: Your current leverage is too high and carries a high risk of liquidation. Please adjust your position.
marginRatio-Tip: Margin Ratio = Maintenance Margin / Remaining Position Margin. When the ratio reaches 100%, the position will be liquidated.
margin_lack_cannot_open: Available margin is too low to open a position.
markPriceFutureTip: The mark price is determined by the real-time index price and basis rate, and is used to trigger liquidation.
markPriceTips: The mark price is determined by the real-time index price and upcoming funding rate, reflecting the fair price of the futures. It is used to trigger liquidation.
markPriceToLiquidationPriceDistance: Difference between Mark Price and Estimated Liquidation Price
maxSizeByLvg: Max. position size available under current leverage
mergeModelExplain: Merge Mode: Orders with the same direction (Long or Short) on the same trading pair will be merged into one position. Each pair can only have one Long and one Short position, and leverage is adjusted uniformly.
mergeSplitBeforeSwitchTip: There are existing positions or active orders. Please close positions and cancel all orders before switching position modes.
movingTp/sl-Tip: Trailing TP/SL is an exit strategy that follows market price movements. Once set, when the latest price reaches the highest/lowest point and retraces by the preset rate, a market close will be triggered.
multiViewTipsDesc: Multi-Chart Mode: freely display multiple trading pairs
occupyTip: Total margin of all locked positions in Cross Margin + all Isolated position margins
oneClickCloseTriggerDesc: Once enabled, one-click close requires a second confirmation
openAPostionDesc11: Select "Cross Margin Mode" or "Isolated Margin Mode"
openAPostionDesc23: Select the position to close【Buy or Sell】
orHintContentCancel: Changing the price to {{price}} may cause the order to be canceled immediately
orHintContentCancelByQty: Changing the quantity to {{qty}} may cause the order to be canceled immediately
orHintContentExec: Changing the price to {{price}} may cause the order to fill immediately
orHintContentTrigger: Changing the price to {{price}} may trigger the order immediately
orMovingTpslPriceContent: The activation price of {{symbol}} Futures has been changed from {{oTPrice}} to {{nTPrice}}
orPriceContent: The order price of {{symbol}} Futures has been changed from {{oPrice}} to {{nPrice}}
orQtyContent: The order quantity of {{symbol}} Futures has been changed from {{oQty}} to {{nQty}}
orTPriceContent: The trigger price of {{symbol}} Futures has been changed from {{oTPrice}} to {{nTPrice}}
orderBookQuickOperate: Quick cancel active orders will apply to the order table
orderCancelTips: Click to cancel {{size}} active orders at this price
orderCreateSuccessWithPriceModifiedInver: Order placed successfully. Due to limit price rules, the order price has been adjusted
orderFillNoticeDesc: {{type}} {{execQty}} {{symbol}} Futures at price {{price}}, order fully filled.
orderLineNoPrompt: Do not show again (can be re-enabled in trading preferences)
orderPartialFillNoticeDesc: {{type}} {{execQty}} {{symbol}} Futures at price {{price}}, {{leavesQty}} Futures remain unfilled.
orderType-Tip: Order types include: Limit Order, Market Order, Limit Add Position, Market Add Position, Market Take Profit, Market Stop Loss, and Market Trigger Order.
orderValue-Tip: Nominal value refers to the price or value of an asset, service, or item at a specific point in time or over a specific period, without considering inflation or other factors. It is determined by market conditions and the value of the currency at that time and does not account for changes in the general price level.
partialEffectTxt: A position can have multiple TP/SL orders, each linked to a partial quantity
partialTp/sl-Tip: Multiple TP/SL orders can be set for partial positions. When the TP or SL trigger price is reached, the corresponding quantity will be closed via market or limit order. If both TP and SL are set, triggering one will automatically cancel the other.
partialTpSlExplainInOrder: After the current order is filled, new partial TP/SL orders will only be created based on the filled quantity.
plsCloseInPosition: In Split Mode, please close the position directly from the position panel
pnl-Tip: The PnL from closing price differences excludes trading fees. During settlement, losses will first be deducted from the Trial Bonus.
pnl-liquidationPrice-Tip: The liquidation price is calculated by the exchange based on the user's initial margin, the futures maintenance margin parameters, and the account balance, and will dynamically adjust with the mark price. When the mark price reaches or falls below the liquidation price (Long) or rises above the liquidation price (Short), liquidation will be triggered.
positionEffectTxt: Each position can only have one TP/SL. The latest TP/SL will override the previous one.
positionMarketClosedSuccessDesc: {{qty}} {{symbol}} Futures will be executed at the latest traded price {{side}}
positionModalDesc: Once enabled, the order confirmation pop-up requires a second confirmation.
positionModeTipWhenSet: When there are open positions or orders, switching between One-way Mode and Hedge Mode is not allowed. This setting only applies to the current derivatives pair.
postOnlyTips: Post-only orders can only be executed as maker orders. If the order would immediately match as a taker, it will be automatically canceled.
pozUpdateSuccess: Position leverage updated successfully. Please check the updated liquidation price.
priceEmptyTipInMovingTpsl: Please enter a valid trigger price
priceErrorTickTip: Invalid price. Please enter a multiple of {{tickSize}}
qtyErrorTickTip: Invalid amount. Please enter a multiple of {{tickSize}}
reAuthFailTip: Real-time data push authentication failed. This may affect real-time updates for your orders, wallet, and positions. Please refresh the page to re-authenticate.
realizedGains-Tip: Realized PnL = Closed PnL - Opening Fee - Closing Fee - Funding Fee
reduceOnlyCantSetTpsl: Close position orders do not support Take Profit / Stop Loss settings
reduceOnlyTips: Reduce-Only orders will only decrease your position and will not increase it. If the order may increase your position, the system will automatically reduce or cancel it.
requestTimeOut: Network connection is unstable. Please switch network routes and try again.
retracePercentage-tip: The Callback Ratio is the key factor in calculating the actual trigger price. The trigger price is derived from the historical high/low and the retracement rate. For example, with a 5% trailing exit and a historical high of 10,000, the trigger price for market close would be 10,000 × (1-5%) = 9,500.
reverse-trade-confirm-des: Once enabled, reverse order confirmation requires a second confirmation.
reverseClickDesc: Once enabled, quick reverse requires a second confirmation.
reversePosition-Tip: You can instantly close the current position at market price and open an opposite position with the same size.
reverseTooltip: If margin is insufficient to open an opposite position, the reverse function will only close the position.
rpnl-Tip: Settled PnL includes all realized PnL from orders, as well as trading fees and position funding fees.
setMarginWarn: You can only remove up to the added margin amount
setTpSuccess: Take Profit / Stop Loss order set successfully
shortSideSlLessPrice: The SL price is lower than the latest price and will execute immediately. Please reset it.
shortSideSlLessPrice-condition: The SL price is lower than the trigger price and will execute immediately. Please reset it.
shortSideSlLessPrice-limit: The SL price is lower than the order price and will execute immediately. Please reset it.
shortSideTpMorePrice: The TP price is higher than the latest price and will execute immediately. Please reset it.
shortSideTpMorePrice-condition: The TP price is higher than the trigger price and will execute immediately. Please reset it.
shortSideTpMorePrice-limit: The TP price is higher than the order price and will execute immediately. Please reset it.
showTradeHistoryTip: Trade history display only shows data from the past 30 days and is only available on candlestick charts with intervals ≤ 1 day.
singlePositionDesc: In one-way mode, a futures contract can only hold one directional position.
slTriggerPriceAttention: Due to rapid market changes, the SL trigger price should not be too close to the estimated liquidation price to avoid trigger failure.
slTriggerPriceAttention_buyLess: Your SL trigger price is less than or equal to the estimated liquidation price, which may cause liquidation before the SL is triggered. Please adjust the trigger price.
slTriggerPriceAttention_buyLess_tips: Your SL price is lower than the estimated liquidation price, which may cause liquidation before the SL order is executed.
slTriggerPriceAttention_sellMore: Your SL trigger price is greater than or equal to the estimated liquidation price, which may cause liquidation before the SL is triggered. Please adjust the trigger price.
slTriggerPriceAttention_sellMore_tips: Your SL price is higher than the estimated liquidation price, which may cause liquidation before the SL order is executed.
splitModelExplain: Split Mode: Under the same direction (long or short) and trading pair, multiple positions can be opened. Each position can have its own leverage. New orders will not merge with existing positions.
stockIsClosing: The market is currently closed and will reopen at {{ time }} (UTC+8).
subLiqNoticeDesc: Your {{symbol}}{{side}} position has been partially liquidated for {{subQty}} futures at price {{price}}.
switchOpenOrderLine: Show or hide quick order function and position information
switchTpslInFull: All positions already have TP/SL orders, so switching to partial-position TP/SL mode is not allowed.
switchTpslInPart: Some positions already have TP/SL orders, so switching to full-position TP/SL mode is not allowed.
tifTips:
Time in Force 
• GTC (Good Till Cancel): Order will continue to work until filled or canceled.
 • IOC (Immediate Or Cancel): Order will execute all or partially immediately and cancel any unfilled portion of the order. 
• FOK (Fill Or Kill): Order must be filled immediately in its entirety, or canceled entirely.
timeZoneOption24hDesc: Price change is based on the past 24 hours' data; K-line data is calculated starting at 00:00 (UTC+0).
timeZoneOptionUTC0Desc: Price change and K-line data are calculated starting at 00:00 UTC.
timeZoneOptionUTC8Desc: Price change and K-line data are calculated starting at 00:00 UTC+8.
timezoneSettingTitle: Price Change Cycle and K-Line Timezone
tipReverseOpenShort: If funds are insufficient, a smaller reverse position will be opened based on available margin. The position size will also be limited by the max. market order size per trade. Please note that reverse position opening depends on market conditions, margin requirements, and risk management, so success cannot be guaranteed.
tips-PMAsset: Position margin is the sum of margin for all open positions
tips-PreOpen: Est. buy/sell amount is calculated based on order size, leverage, price, pair precision, and limited by max position size and max order size per trade.
tips-PreOpen-margin: Est. buy/sell value is calculated based on order size, leverage, price, pair precision, and limited by max position size and max order size per trade.
tips-PreSell: Est. closing value is calculated based on order size, leverage, price, pair precision, and limited by position size and max close order size.
tips-PreSell-margin: Estimated closable value is calculated based on order size, leverage, price, pair precision, and limited by position size and max close order size.
tips-accountEquity: Asset equity = wallet balance of the asset + unrealized PnL of the asset
tips-avaliableAsset: Available margin is the margin that can be used to open positions, including unrealized PnL from cross-margin positions
tips-closeTotalPnl_cn: Total Realized PnL is the sum of PnL from all closed positions
tips-deduction_bouns: Can be used to pay trading fees but cannot offset losses or be used as margin.
tips-experience_bonus: Can be used for opening positions, calculating PnL when closing, and offsetting trading and funding fees. Not withdrawable. Transferring futures funds out will invalidate the bonus.
tips-liqPrice: Estimated liquidation price for open positions, which will keep changing. This price is for reference only and may differ from the actual liquidation price.
tips-occupy: Used = locked position margin of all pairs in cross mode + total isolated margin of all pairs + total frozen opening costs
tips-openMax: The max. open position is calculated based on available margin, leverage, price, pair precision, and is limited by max position size and max order size per trade.
tips-openMax-long-label-margin: Max. margin available to Open Long
tips-openMax-margin: Max. margin to open = max open value / leverage. The max open value is calculated based on available margin, leverage, price, pair precision, and is also limited by max position size and max order size per trade.
tips-openMax-short-label-margin: Max. margin available to Open Short
tips-roi: Unrealized PnL rate = total unrealized PnL / total margin used by all positions
tips-sellMax: Max closable value is calculated based on position size, leverage, price, pair precision, and max close size per order.
tips-sellMax-long-label-margin: Maximum margin available to Close Long
tips-sellMax-margin: Maximum margin to close = max closable value / leverage. The value is calculated based on position size, leverage, price, pair precision, and max close size per order.
tips-sellMax-short-label-margin: Max. margin available to Close Short
tips-totalRealisedPnl: Total Realized PnL = Sum of Closed Position PnL - Total Trading Fees - Total Funding Fees During Positions
tips-totalUnrealisedPnl: Current total unrealized PnL calculated using mark price
tp/slTips: Please enter order price and futures quantity first
tp/slTipsDesc: When {{priceType}}{{goingType}} reaches {{price}}, a {{orderType}} market order will be triggered. Estimated {{type}}{{pnl}} {{coin}}.
tpsl-Tip: The TP/SL orders will be created automatically when the limit/market/trigger orders are executed.
tpslOptionTipContent: In “Full Mode”, one position can only have one TP/SL. In “Partial Mode”, a position can have multiple TP/SL orders with different quantities and prices.
tpslPreferenceTipContent: If the current position has no TP/SL set, you can switch between “Full Mode” and “Partial Mode”.
tpslRoiTip: Current leverage cannot reach this profit rate
tradeSide-Tip: Direction indicates whether you are opening long/short or closing long/short.
tradeType-Tip: Direction indicates whether you are opening long/short or closing long/short.
trailingStopTips: A trailing stop will allow a stop order to follow the last traded price based on a pre-set distance and direction, and will automatically move to lock in the profit or stop loss.
traingStopCantSetTpsl: Trailing stop order does not support TP/SL
transerInAmountAfterLvgChange: After adjustment, {{value}} will be transferred from the account as additional margin (based on the actual transferred amount).
transerOutAmountAfterLvgChange: After adjustment, the position margin will decrease by {{value}} (based on the actual transferred amount).
triggerPrice-Tip: When the latest price or mark price reaches the trigger price, a market or limit order will be placed according to the set quantity and direction.
updateTime-Tip: Time when the order was fully executed or canceled
upnl-Tip2: Note: For display only. It does not affect margin calculations. Actual PnL is based on executed trades.
whetherOneClickReverse: Please confirm if you want to place a "Quick Reversal" order.
